innova-teebird3.line: Feels more controllable and more trustworthy in wind than the TeeBird

dynamic-discs-getaway.line: Very comparable to a Fission Tesla when thrown side by side

innova-thunderbird.line: Holds its hyzer where the Tesla flips out slightly; a Fission Tesla may fly similarly

mvp-volt.line: Slower than the Tesla, with a different enough flight that some still bag both

mvp-inertia.line: Turns a little more than the Tesla, which flies a bit straighter

axiom-virus.line: Flies about as far as the Tesla but on a different line, less reliably

axiom-insanity.line: Far more overstable than the Tesla

discmania-pd.line: Close to Neutron Tesla stability, a slot beaten-in Teslas could challenge

axiom-crave.line: Shorter than a well-used Tesla, which may start flying like it

dynamic-discs-trespass.line: Overlaps with the Tesla for light to moderate headwinds and stable shots

axiom-pyro.line: Dumpier fade than the Reactor, which flexes out later and less abruptly

axiom-hex.line: Slightly less stable than the Reactor, with a similarly comfortable feel in hand

discraft-buzzz.line: Very similar flight and feel to the Reactor, but less forehand stable

mvp-matrix.line: Closest in the lineup to the Reactor, with more S curve and faster beat in

dynamic-discs-emac-truth.line: Holds up to a forehand less well than the Reactor
